# Interpersonal Relationship

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InterpersonalRelationship>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified standing relationship between agents (acquaintance, collaboration, …), able to bear its own time interval, confidence, and source evidence.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a standing tie between agents must be first-class — carrying its own interval, confidence, or source evidence — beyond what the flat gmeow:hasMet/hasWorkedWith shortcuts can hold.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the bare symmetric fact (use the flat shortcuts) and avoid using it for a contact channel or an address tenure (those are [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](gmeow-ContactPoint.md) and [`gmeow:AddressTenure`](gmeow-AddressTenure.md)).

### How to use

- Mint the relator, bind its agents with [`gmeow:relationshipParty`](../properties/gmeow-relationshipParty.md) (at least one is required by axiom), and carry its span with [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](../properties/gmeow-relationshipInterval.md); specialize to Professional or Acquaintance where the kind is known.

### Examples

- ex:tie a [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md); [`gmeow:relationshipParty`](../properties/gmeow-relationshipParty.md) ex:lillith, ex:morgan.
